workflow: Researcher subagent commits its own RESEARCH.md artifact — orchestrator should not try to commit it separately.
Running a git commit in background while concurrently spawning another subagent (which may also touch git) causes index.lock races; serialize commits or wait for subagents to finish first.
GSD plan-phase flow: research → Nyquist VALIDATION.md → commit artifacts → pattern-mapper → API-surface regen → planner → checker verification loop.
The drift-check gate (§5.65) is non-blocking; stale-baseline noise from top-level config/repo files should be noted but not treated as a blocker.
Schema-gate hook skips silently when no schema-relevant files are in scope for a phase.
